MCalc 1.0.0 — first stable release.

New

- **Backup & restore**: export your settings, history, and custom layout to a file and import them back
- **Quick navigation** from all settings screen back to the calculator
- Restored backups apply instantly, no restart needed
- Faster app startup (AOT compilation)

Fixes

- Optimize the calculation logic
- Results that were tiny but non-zero now display as `0` instead of floating-point errors
- Negative exponents are substituted correctly
- Trigonometric operators apply correctly
- Snackbar notifications appear properly

Note

- The app identifier was fixed (the beta had a typo). If you installed the beta, 1.0.0 will appear as a new app — you will have to manually copy relevant data.
